Claude scheduled tasks: set a recurring task once and let Claude run it in the cloud. 3 steps, paid plans only.

Claude scheduled tasks: set it once, it runs every week. Here is how, in three steps.

1. Open - Open Scheduled in the sidebar.
2. Describe - Choose Create with Claude, then set the task and frequency.
3. Relax - It runs in the cloud, even with your laptop off. Cloud tasks cannot use local folders.

Needs: Pro, Max, Team, Ent.
